_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits at the top of Disbelief with canceling factors and no vol/funding expansion; base-rate coil favors holding the rung until a clear breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — both cautionary, but analyst forward is explicit HOLD/Disbelief while narrative only supplies hedging color without a phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed and 30d momentum remain high-50s/low-60s with flat funding and no vol expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G/momentum push through ~70 with ETF inflows (up to Hope) or break under ~50 with negative funding and rising haven/vol (down to Complacency)
